# veogen - full corpus

AI media generation hub (video/music/image/chat/movie scripts) on Google's Gemini family.
Backend: FastAPI + SQLite on 11150. Frontend: React 18 + Vite on 11151 (bun).
FastMCP streamable HTTP surface at /mcp. See README.md for quick start and config.

## MCP tools (at /mcp)
- veogen_status - server version, provider state
- list_personas - available chat personas
- movie_script - generate a movie script via Gemini (title, concept, style, max_clips)
- generate_video / generate_image / generate_music - honest provider_not_wired stubs until wired

## Config
Env: GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY (chat + scripts), SECRET_KEY (JWT, >= 32 chars),
model IDs GEMINI_PRO_MODEL / GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL / VEO_MODEL / LYRIA_MODEL / IMAGEN_MODEL.
Config read from backend/.env, fallback repo-root .env. See backend/.env.example.

## Repo map
- backend/app/main.py - app, /health, /api/v1/diagnostics, /mcp mount
- backend/app/api/router.py - v1 aggregator
- backend/app/mcp_server.py - FastMCP tools
- backend/app/services/gemini_service.py - provider facade
- frontend/src/App.js - routes; frontend/e2e/smoke.spec.ts - Playwright suite
- justfile - serve/dev/test/lint/e2e recipes
